narrative.intro: Thalle Construction has $1.9B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Thalle Construction recorded 3 awards so far this fiscal year, producing an average award size of $639M and obligations that are up 571.4% year over year. Department of Defense is the dominant buyer, providing $1.9B in obligations to Thalle Construction in FY2026 to date. Department of the Interior has also obligated $114K to Thalle Construction in the current fiscal year. Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction is the largest market for Thalle Construction with $1.9B in obligations, while Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction accounts for $114K. Fiscal-year history shows Thalle Construction obligations of $167M in FY21, $213M in FY22, $16.1M in FY23, $366M in FY24, and $285M in FY25, before the current-year total of $1.9B. All figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables. Current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date).
